Come A Little Closer, Zainab…

Don't rush. Read these slowly, because each one carries a little piece of my heart, يا حبيبتي.

01

I miss you… not only when you're far away, but sometimes even when you're right there, because my heart always wants a little more of you, حياتي.

02

When I sleep at night, you always find your way into my dreams. 🌙 I don't invite you there… somehow my heart already knows where it wants to go.

03

04

You are my happiness. And when your smile appears, something inside me smiles too.

05

06

I don't like to see you angry or hurting. I want your heart to feel peaceful.

07

If one day you feel tired, remember that you don't have to hide every feeling behind a smile. Come as you are, يا قلبي. Your feelings matter.

08

09

There are moments when I see something beautiful and immediately think, “Zainab would love this.” That's how quietly you became part of my everyday thoughts.

10

11

12

13

Maybe I cannot describe everything I feel perfectly. But if you remember only one thing from all these words, remember this:

I care about you. I miss you. I think about you. And you are very special to me. ❤️
